details: `normalize` and `is_normalized` follow x/text's stream-safe text (a U+034F after 30 non-starters in a row), so a long run of combining marks normalizes in linear time (it was quadratic: about 22 s for 1 MB of marks) and such text normalizes as Go's does. Affected: 0.38.0 to 0.51.1.
changelog: - Security (std/norm, every backend): `normalize` and `is_normalized` follow x/text's stream-safe text (a U+034F after 30 non-starters in a row), so a long run of combining marks normalizes in linear time (it was quadratic: about 22 s for 1 MB of marks) and such text normalizes as Go's does. Affected: 0.38.0 to 0.51.1.
